text: No, the land-change method could not evaluate this property due to insufficient data. Key datasets (Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020, MGAP 2021) were unavailable for this asset, leaving no observation sources to assess tree-cover loss between 2021 and 2025. The evidence is inconclusive—it neither confirms nor rules out tree-cover loss, nor does it support any compliance findings (e.g., EUDR status). The gap stems from missing coverage in the monitoring sources, not the method itself. Further investigation would require alternative data.
